en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small Central European town surrounded by rolling hills and patchwork fields. In the foreground are clustered houses, a prominent church with a steeple, and larger institutional-looking buildings. The landscape stretches into cultivated farmland and low hills. Printed German text appears below the image, including a greeting mentioning 'Sommerfrische Duppau' and publisher information.
